sum: Credits pay for crafting, blueprints and mod fusion; The Index on Neptune is the go-to farm, with Profit-Taker and Techrot Safes paying even more for veterans.

ways.how: Pick the High Risk investment (50,000 credits), collect Index Points from killed enemies and bank them faster than the Corpus team. Keep going for more rounds before extracting.
ways.why: Each High Risk round you win pays 250,000 credits, and the game is built around wagering, so it is the best credit farm for newer players. A Credit Booster increases the payout.

ways.how: Run the Vox Solaris heist and defeat the Profit-Taker Orb atop the Enrichment Labs in the Orb Vallis.
ways.why: The kill drops 125,000 credits as a pickup, so Chroma's Effigy, Credit Boosters, a Credit Blessing and Prosperous/Loyal Retriever all multiply it.
ways.req: Old Mate rank with Solaris United, an Archgun with Gravimag, and a strong loadout

ways.how: Find and open the Techrot Safe in a Höllvania mission. Shell Cracker bounties mark the safe on your map, and the Orokin Eye Air Support highlights its key.
ways.why: A safe gives 100,000 Höllars (credits) as a pickup, so every multiplier stacks on it: with Effigy, a Credit Blessing and a Retriever proc it shows 450,000, and a Credit Booster doubles that to 900,000.

ways.how: Play the Disruption mission on Laomedeia and clear rounds quickly.
ways.why: It awards 30,000 credits per B rotation and 50,000 per C rotation, and fast teams can out-earn The Index. These are Credit Caches, so boosters apply but the Daily First Win Bonus does not.

ways.how: Make an Arbitration your first mission after the Daily Tribute, and finish all three Sortie missions each day.
ways.why: Arbitrations always pay 50,000 credits per completion, which the Daily First Win Bonus doubles to 100,000. Sorties pay 100,000 credits in total once per day.
ways.req: Arbitrations: Pluto access and the Eris junction lens task. Sorties: MR5 and The War Within

ways.how: Run Hieracon Excavation and extract after the first excavator finishes, or do Sechura (Pluto), Seimeni or Gabii (Ceres) for 5 minutes or 3 waves.
ways.why: Hieracon pays 20,000 credits in under 5 minutes, and the other Dark Sectors also pay 20,000 for a short run. Each extra squad member adds about 1,000.

ways.how: Clear Railjack missions solo, such as all of Earth Proxima, or Neptune and Pluto Proxima for a bit more pay.
ways.why: Missions usually pay 30,000-40,000 credits each, Neptune and Pluto Proxima at least 50,000, and Veil Proxima at least 100,000 at much higher enemy levels.

tips: A Credit Booster doubles credit gains, and Login Tribute boosters extend an active one.
Ask an MR30 player in a Relay for a Credit Blessing: 25% more credits for 3 hours.
Chroma's Effigy doubles big pickups like the Profit-Taker and Techrot Safe drops.
Sell spare blueprints, mods and Captura scenes from your inventory; use the 'sellable only' filter.

sum: Endo ranks up your mods; the fastest farm is Steel Path Rathuum on Sedna with a loot squad, and Arbitrations are a strong steady source.

ways.how: Run the Rathuum arena at Yam or Vodyanoi on Sedna in The Steel Path, ideally with a full squad. Bring loot frames such as Nekros with Despoil, Nidus, or Khora with Pilfering Strangledome.
ways.why: The Steel Path doubles Mod and Endo drop chance, and a squad with loot frames can reach upwards of 75,000 Endo per hour.

ways.how: Stay in an Arbitration for an hour or more, collecting rotation rewards that include Endo and Ayatan Sculptures.
ways.why: With one reward every 5 minutes, an hour averages about 11,796 Endo (counting filled Ayatan Sculptures). Staying longer earns more.
ways.req: Pluto access and the Eris junction lens task

ways.how: Complete all three Sortie missions each day.
ways.why: The reward can be 4,000 Endo, an Anasa Ayatan Sculpture worth 3,450 Endo when filled, a Legendary Core (saves up to 40,920 Endo) or a 3-day Mod Drop Chance Booster.
ways.req: MR5, The War Within, and Oro (Earth) completed

ways.how: Buy the rotating 30,000 Endo offering from Teshin in any Relay when it appears.
ways.why: 30,000 Endo for 150 Steel Essence, available once every 8 weeks.

ways.how: Do Maroo's weekly treasure hunt from her Bazaar on Mars (it resets every Monday), then fill and cash in the sculpture.
ways.why: A guaranteed sculpture worth 1,425-2,700 Endo once filled with Ayatan Stars, and it can be traded instead.

ways.how: Run high-level bounties such as the Cambion Drift 40-60 bounty, scrap unwanted Railjack salvage, and dissolve duplicate mods in your Orbiter.
ways.why: The Cambion Drift 40-60 bounty has a 45.45% chance of 1,000 Endo on stage 1. Railjack components scrap for 75-300 Endo by Mk tier, and the Daily Synthesis task gives 250-800.

tips: Only the Mod Drop Chance Booster affects Endo; Resource Boosters and Relay blessings do nothing for it.
Fill Ayatan Sculptures with stars before giving them to Maroo to get the full value.
Use Legendary Cores on Primed or Umbra mods, where they save the most Endo.
Enemy Endo orbs come in 15, 50 and 80 sizes.

sum: Kuva cycles Riven mods and builds rare blueprints; Kuva Floods are the main farm, topped up by weekly vendor buys from Steel Essence, Riven Slivers and Voidplumes.

ways.how: Do the Kuva Flood mission on the planet the Kuva Fortress is orbiting, catching Kuva clouds with Operator Void Beam or Void Sling.
ways.why: Each Flood awards 1,100-1,400 Kuva, double a regular Siphon, and Resource Boosters apply.

ways.how: Run the regular Kuva Siphon missions marked with the Kuva icon near the Kuva Fortress.
ways.why: Each destroyed Siphon gives around 550-700 Kuva at an easier level 25-35.

ways.how: Trade Steel Essence to Teshin in any Relay for Kuva packs.
ways.why: 10,000 Kuva for 15 Steel Essence, up to 25 times per week (250,000 total). The rotating 50,000-for-55 offer every 8 weeks gives more per Essence.

ways.how: Grab the weekly Kuva offers: Palladino in Iron Wake, Archimedean Yonta in the Chrysalith, plus Flare, Acrithis, Nightcap, Aspirant Zorba and Cephalon Melica.
ways.why: Palladino and Yonta each sell 35,000 Kuva weekly (10 Riven Slivers or 5 Voidplume Pinions). Several others sell 6,000 a pack up to 7 times a week (42,000 each).
ways.req: Varies by vendor (e.g. Chains of Harrow for Palladino)

ways.t: Steel Path Circuit, Archon Hunts and Sorties
ways.how: Pick Kuva as a Steel Path Circuit tier reward, and complete weekly Archon Hunts and daily Sorties.
ways.why: The Circuit offers 20,000 Kuva at tier 5 or 10 once per week. Archon Hunts have a 12% chance of 12,000, Sorties 12% for 6,000.
ways.req: The Steel Path; Veilbreaker for Archon Hunts

ways.how: Run Cetus, Fortuna or Necralisk bounties, or Kuva Survival on Taveuni and Disruption on Tamu.
ways.why: Bounties pay 100-300 (Cetus), 500 (Fortuna) and 750 (Necralisk). Tamu Disruption gives 100/200/350 per A/B/C tier, plus 50 per Demolisher.

tips: Resource Boosters double Siphon and Flood Kuva, but not Tamu Disruption rotation rewards.
Spend Nightwave Creds on the 10,000 Kuva offering (50 Creds) when spare.
Arbitration Honors sell 10,000 Kuva for 25 Vitus Essence.
Parazon-finishing a Kuva Lich drops 150-300 Kuva depending on its rank.

sum: Ducats buy Baro Ki'Teer's exclusive items; you get them by selling Prime parts at the Ducat kiosks in any Relay, and gold (rare) parts pay the most.

ways.t: Sell Prime parts at Relay kiosks
ways.how: Open Void Relics, then sell spare Prime blueprints, weapon parts and crafted Prime Warframe components at the Void Trader kiosks in any Relay's Concourse.
ways.why: Common (bronze) parts are worth 15 Ducats, uncommon (silver) 45 and rare (gold) 100. The kiosks are always open, even when Baro is away.

ways.t: Crack Radiant relics for gold parts
ways.how: Refine relics with Void Traces and run Fissures in a squad, focusing on getting rare drops to sell.
ways.why: A single rare part is worth 100 Ducats, almost seven commons.

ways.t: Buy cheap Prime parts from players
ways.how: Buy unwanted Prime parts cheaply from other players in trade chat, then sell them at the kiosks.
ways.why: Ducats themselves cannot be traded, but the parts can, so this turns Platinum into Ducats.
ways.req: MR2 and Two-Factor Authentication to trade

ways.how: Exchange Aya with Varzia in Maroo's Bazaar for Ducats.
ways.why: A way to turn spare Aya into Ducats without opening relics.

ways.how: Buy the Void Surplus that Baro Ki'Teer sells once per visit for 50,000 credits.
ways.why: It has a 2% chance to contain 1,000 Ducats, so it is a small bonus, not a main source.

tips: Parts that were rarer on vaulted relics but are common on newer ones are worth 25 or 65 Ducats.
Crafted Prime Warframe parts can still go to the kiosk, but they can no longer be traded to players, so decide before you build.
Stockpile Ducats before Baro arrives so you can buy his items right away.

sum: Platinum is the premium currency; outside of buying it, the way to earn it is trading tradable items (Prime parts and sets, Mods, Arcanes, Rivens, Relics) with other players.

ways.t: Sell Prime parts and full sets
ways.how: Open Void Relics and sell Prime blueprints and weapon parts in trade chat or Maroo's Bazaar. Full sets include the main blueprint plus every part.
ways.why: Prime parts are the most common tradable reward, and players buy them to skip the relic farm. Vaulted relics stay tradable too.

ways.how: Unveil Riven Mods from Sorties and other sources and sell the ones you won't use.
ways.why: Rivens are tradable and unique to each roll, so a good one can sell for a lot.

ways.how: Sell spare Arcane Enhancements (ranked or unranked) and tradable mods from your farms.
ways.why: Arcanes and many mods are tradable, so leftovers from Eidolons, bounties and Arbitrations turn into Platinum.

ways.t: Sell Syndicate gear, Ayatans and other tradables
ways.how: Sell Syndicate weapons, armor and emotes, Ayatan Sculptures, relics and other items in the tradable list.
ways.why: Spare Syndicate standing turns into Platinum this way. Tradable weapons sell as long as they have no affinity, Forma, Lens or Catalyst.

ways.how: Post WTS offers in the in-game Trade chat, set up shop in Maroo's Bazaar on Mars, or meet in a Clan Dojo trading post.
ways.why: Maroo's Bazaar has a fixed 10% hub tax on top of the credit trade tax, while a Dojo can charge 0-100%.

tips: You get daily trades equal to your Mastery Rank; ranking up gives one more immediately.
Starting and giveaway Platinum can't be traded, only bought or traded Platinum.
Baro Ki'Teer's arrival can crash prices for his items, and vaulting changes relic prices.
Double-check item names, mod ranks and the Platinum amount before clicking OK; trades can't be undone.

sum: Void Traces refine relics to Radiant and craft Dragon Keys; you earn them from Reactant in Void Fissures, and an endless Fissure with boosters is the fastest farm.

ways.how: Run an endless Fissure, ideally Defense where Reactant is easy to collect, and pick up 10 Reactant each rotation.
ways.why: Each relic opening gives 6-30 Traces. Endless missions also hand out bonus Resource Boosters, and with every multiplier one relic can give up to 495.

ways.how: Run Fissure missions with no relic equipped (solo or with a premade squad) and collect 10 Reactant.
ways.why: You still get the 6-30 Traces without spending your relics.

ways.t: Public squads where others pick your reward
ways.how: Open relics in squads; when teammates pick the reward from your relic you get bonus Traces.
ways.why: 5 bonus Traces per teammate who picks yours, up to 15 extra.

ways.how: Spend a Granum Crown at a Golden Hand Tribute on a Corpus Ship and kill Errant Specters.
ways.why: The Rank 1 reward includes 5/10/15 Traces for Normal/Extended/Nightmare.

ways.how: Trade Aya to Varzia in Maroo's Bazaar for Void Traces.
ways.why: Turns spare Aya into Traces when you need them.

tips: Your cap is MR x 50 + 100 (750 at MR13, 1,600 at MR30); extra is lost.
Resource Boosters, Resource Weekends and Loyal/Resourceful Retriever all double the Trace reward.
Radiant costs 100 Traces, Flawless 50, Exceptional 25.

sum: Aya buys vaulted relics from Varzia's Prime Resurgence; it drops from Void missions and bounties, taking the place of vaulted relics.

ways.how: Run missions on Void nodes; each completion guarantees either a relic or Aya.
ways.why: Aya drops in place of vaulted relics, so Void missions are the steady source.

ways.how: Run open-world bounties such as Cetus, Fortuna and Necralisk ones.
ways.why: Aya replaces vaulted relics in bounty reward tables too.

ways.how: Open Relic Packs from Syndicate offerings or the in-game Market.
ways.why: Packs occasionally contain Aya.

tips: Varzia also trades Aya for Ducats and Void Traces.
Faction Syndicates need 2 Aya for Rank 4 and 3 for Rank 5, so keep a few.
Varzia's stock changes every 28 days at 18:00 UTC; check before spending.

sum: Regal Aya buys vaulted Prime Warframes, weapons and accessories directly from Varzia; it is only sold for real money and can't be traded.

ways.how: Purchase Regal Aya packs at the Prime Resurgence page on the official Warframe website.
ways.why: Packs come with bonus Platinum (up to 1,200 in the largest pack).

ways.how: Buy Regal Aya through the in-game Market on any platform.
ways.why: Same product, available without leaving the game.

ways.how: Farm regular Aya from Void missions and bounties and buy the vaulted relics, then open them yourself.
ways.why: Gets the same vaulted Primes without paying, at the cost of relic farming.

tips: Items bought with Regal Aya come with a slot and a Catalyst or Reactor installed.
Buying from Varzia bypasses Mastery Rank locks on Prime weapons.
Prime accessories like Syandanas and Sugatras are Regal Aya only.

sum: Riven Slivers buy Rivens, Kuva and Requiem items from Palladino; they drop from Eximus units, so Eximus-heavy Steel Path missions with resource boosts are the best farm.

ways.how: Run endless Steel Path missions and kill every Eximus, stacking resource drop bonuses.
ways.why: Eximus above level 30 have a 2% chance to drop one, and the Steel Path's bonus drop chance raises that further.

ways.how: Do Sorties or Abyssal Zone Orokin Defixios with the Eximus Stronghold condition.
ways.why: Eximus spawn much more often, so more chances at a Sliver.

ways.how: Play Höllvania missions, especially Faceoff where opponents can spawn 5 Eximus with Eximus Influx.
ways.why: Eximus spawn at an increased rate in Höllvania.

ways.how: Open Requiem Relics in Void Fissures and run Empyrean missions.
ways.why: Both list Riven Slivers as rewards.

ways.how: Fight Jackal at level 41+ (Sortie or Steel Path).
ways.why: 5% chance to drop 1 Sliver.
ways.req: The Steel Path or a Sortie

tips: Slivers count as resources: Resource Boosters, Drop Chance Boosters, Retriever mods, Atlas Ore Gaze, Khora Pilfering Strangledome and Wukong all help.
Pick them up fast; Sliver drops despawn after about 2 minutes.
Spend 10 on Palladino's 35,000 Kuva each week, or on a Riven Mod (10 Slivers, twice a week).
Operation: Belly of the Beast, when it runs, is full of Jade Light Eximus.

sum: Steel Essence buys Teshin's Steel Path Honors (Umbra Forma, Kuva, arcane adapters and more); daily Incursions plus Acolyte kills are the core farm.

ways.how: Clear the six daily Steel Path Incursion alerts.
ways.why: Each gives 5 Steel Essence, 30 per day.

ways.how: Stay in endless Steel Path missions and kill the Acolytes that spawn, grabbing the drops quickly.
ways.why: Each Acolyte guarantees 2 Steel Essence, doubled by Resource Boosters and Loyal/Resourceful Retriever.

ways.how: Reach Tier 9 of the Steel Path Circuit and floor 18 of Steel Path Descendia each week.
ways.why: 25 Steel Essence each.

ways.t: Clearing the Steel Path Star Chart
ways.how: Complete every node on each planet in The Steel Path.
ways.why: 25 per planet cleared, 475 for the whole Star Chart, a one-time haul.

ways.t: Steel Path Fissures, Orowyrm and Eidolons
ways.how: Open relics in Steel Path Fissures, beat the Orowyrm in Steel Path Duviri, and hunt Eidolons on the Steel Path Plains.
ways.why: 1 per relic opened, 5 from the Orowyrm chest, 1 per Eidolon. Steel Path Undercroft portals give 2 each, up to 6 per run.

tips: Run endless Steel Path with a Resource Booster active to double Acolyte drops.
Grab Acolyte drops right away; they often vanish within 1-3 minutes.
Buying everything in Teshin's permanent stock once takes 408 Essence.

sum: Vitus Essence buys Arbitration Honors (Galvanized mods, arcanes, Kuva and more); it comes only from Arbitrations, so stay long and kill Shield Drones.

ways.how: Stay in an endless Arbitration for many rotations; after the first four, every rotation is a C rotation.
ways.why: Each rotation gives 1 guaranteed Vitus, plus a 10% chance of 3 more from the reward table.
ways.req: Pluto access, the Eris junction lens task, and a Rank 30 Warframe

ways.how: Kill every Arbitration Shield Drone and grab what it drops.
ways.why: Each drone has a 6% chance to drop 1 Vitus, which Resource Boosters and Retriever mods double.

ways.how: Pick Arbitrations on Survival, Defense or Interception.
ways.why: Survival and Defense rotations are short, so Vitus comes faster. Excavation needs two digs per reward.

tips: Use a Resource Booster to double Vitus from Shield Drones.
Failing still keeps rotation rewards already earned; quitting does not.
Drone Vitus can disappear within 1-3 minutes, so pick it up fast.
Buying everything in the Honors shop once takes 1,125 Vitus.

sum: Pathos Clamps buy Drifter melee weapons, Incarnon upgrades and Acrithis' wares; Steel Path Duviri Experience with Undercroft side portals is the best farm.

ways.t: Steel Path Duviri Experience + Undercroft portals
ways.how: Play The Duviri Experience on Steel Path, clear the Undercroft side portals, and beat the Orowyrm at the end.
ways.why: The Orowyrm chest gives 15 Clamps on Steel Path, and each Undercroft side portal adds 3.
ways.req: The Duviri Paradox; The Steel Path

ways.how: Defeat the Duet boss fight against The Fragmented in Isleweaver and open the chest.
ways.why: 10 Clamps (15 on Steel Path) per clear.

ways.how: Run The Duviri Experience on normal difficulty and defeat the Orowyrm.
ways.why: 10 Clamps per Orowyrm chest, plus 1 per Undercroft side portal.

tips: Resource Boosters do nothing for Clamps, so don't save boosters for this.
Getting everything takes about 1,210 Clamps.
Acrithis sells Catalysts, Reactors, Forma blueprints and Kuva for 10-25 Clamps.

sum: Vosfor buys random Arcane collections from Loid (200 Vosfor each); dissolve unwanted Arcanes and claim the weekly and Syndicate packs.

ways.how: Have Loid in the Sanctum Anatomica dissolve your spare and duplicate Arcanes.
ways.why: The amount varies by Arcane, and leftovers from Eidolons, bounties and collections all become Vosfor.

ways.how: Clear Elite Deep Archimedea with enough Research Points.
ways.why: 20 Vosfor at 28 points and 50 at 37 points.
ways.req: Whispers in the Walls, Cavia Rank 5

ways.how: Buy the 200 Vosfor Pack from any of the six main Syndicates at Rank 5.
ways.why: 200 Vosfor for 30,000 standing, a good use of maxed standing.
ways.req: Rank 5 with a faction Syndicate, Whispers in the Walls

ways.how: Buy 200 Vosfor Packs from Kaya for 6 Pix Chips, and play Faceoff missions.
ways.why: Faceoff awards varying amounts of Vosfor.

ways.how: Complete Calendar challenges and pick the 200 Vosfor Pack when offered.
ways.why: A free 200 Vosfor when it shows up.

tips: Each collection costs 200 Vosfor plus 50,000 credits and gives 3 Arcanes.
Pick the collection with the best odds for the Arcane you want (e.g. Steel Collection is 100% rare).
Spend spare faction standing on Vosfor Packs instead of letting it sit.

sum: Lua Thrax Plasm buys Voruna, Perigale, Sarofang and Lua arcanes from Archimedean Yonta; farm it in Conjunction Survival, best on Steel Path Circulus.

ways.how: Play the Steel Path version of Circulus Conjunction Survival and stay for many rotations, killing the Thrax that spawn every 5 minutes.
ways.why: Guaranteed 6 Plasm per rotation, plus each Thrax has a 30% chance to drop more.
ways.req: The War Within; The Steel Path

ways.how: Run normal Circulus Conjunction Survival and kill the Thrax Centurions and Legatus that spawn each rotation (finish Eclipse/Lua variants with Void Beam).
ways.why: Guaranteed 5 Plasm per rotation, plus 30% Thrax drops.

ways.how: Run Yuvarium Conjunction Survival for an easier version.
ways.why: Guaranteed 3 Plasm per rotation (5 on Steel Path).

tips: Play in a squad: Thrax spawns are 2 plus 1 per extra squad member.
Resource Boosters double Plasm from Thrax drops but not the rotation reward.
Plasm drops despawn after 60 seconds, so grab them fast.
Everything from Yonta once takes 1,110 Plasm.

sum: Archon Shards give permanent Warframe stat boosts through the Helminth; the weekly Archon Hunt is guaranteed, and Netracells and Archimedea add several more each week.

ways.how: Complete the weekly Archon Hunt; the Archon rotates between Boreal (Azure), Amar (Crimson) and Nira (Amber).
ways.why: Guaranteed shard of that Archon's color, with a 20% Tauforged chance that rises 20% after each normal one (about 39.83% effective).

ways.how: Run Netracells from Tagfer in the Sanctum Anatomica, spending a Search Pulse each time.
ways.why: The main cache can be a Crimson, Amber or Azure shard (Tauforged as a rare result).

ways.how: Unlock Deep Archimedea with 2 Search Pulses and clear its three missions with as many Research Points as possible.
ways.why: Its main rewards are Crimson, Amber and Azure shards, with Tauforged as rare loot.
ways.req: Whispers in the Walls, Cavia Rank 5

ways.how: Unlock Temporal Archimedea in Höllvania with 2 Search Pulses and clear it.
ways.why: It can award all six colors, including Emerald, Topaz, Violet and Tauforged.
ways.req: The Hex quest, Rank 5 with The Hex

ways.how: Buy the weekly shard from Bird 3 in the Sanctum Anatomica; its color rotates.
ways.why: One normal shard for 30,000 Cavia standing each week.

ways.how: Pick shards from the 1999 Calendar, and finish Infernum 21 of Steel Path Descendia.
ways.why: The Calendar can give any normal shard; Descendia gives normal Crimson, Amber or Azure.

tips: You get 5 Search Pulses a week, shared between Netracells, Deep and Temporal Archimedea.
Fuse two primary colors for Emerald, Topaz or Violet (50 Stela), or three of a color for a Tauforged (100 Stela).
Shards are lost if you sell or subsume a Warframe that has them, so unsocket first.
Search Pulses and Archon Hunts reset Monday 00:00 UTC.

sum: Granum Crowns open the Granum Void and free Solaris captives; kill the Treasurer on a Corpus Ship, and the planet sets the tier (Venus/Mars/Phobos normal, Jupiter/Neptune Exemplar, Neptune/Pluto/Steel Path Zenith).

ways.how: Run quick non-endless Corpus Ship missions and kill the Treasurer before he escapes; he shows up within 2-4 minutes with a waypoint.
ways.why: Only one Treasurer spawns per mission, so short missions get you a Crown fastest. Non-endless missions spawn him sooner than endless ones (5-8 minutes).

ways.t: Zenith Crowns: Pluto, Neptune or Steel Path
ways.how: Farm Corpus Ship missions on Pluto or Neptune, any Steel Path Corpus Ship mission, or any Sisters of Parvos mission.
ways.why: These drop Zenith Crowns, which open the Nightmare Granum Void and free Solaris for 900 standing. Acheron, Cypress, Hydra and Psamathe are good nodes.

ways.how: Farm Corpus Ship missions on Jupiter, or Adrastea and Triton.
ways.why: Exemplar Crowns open the Extended Granum Void and free Solaris for 600 standing.

ways.how: Farm Corpus Ship missions such as Skyresh, Ishtar, Roche or Fossa.
ways.why: Easy early Crowns for the base Granum Void and 300 Solaris standing per captive.

ways.t: Nightmare Mode to upgrade the tier
ways.how: Play Nightmare Mode Corpus Ship missions, which add +10 enemy levels.
ways.why: The higher level can bump the drop up a tier, e.g. Nightmare Jackal on Venus drops an Exemplar Crown.

tips: Vacuum and Fetch don't pull Crowns; pick them up by hand.
Resource Boosters and loot abilities don't affect Crowns.
You can spend a Crown in the same mission you got it.
The Treasurer doesn't spawn on Valac (Europa) or if you're within 35 m of extraction.

sum: Nightwave Cred buys items from the Nightwave Cred Offerings (Catalysts, Reactors, Kuva, Nitain and more); earn it by ranking up Nightwave through daily and weekly Acts.

ways.how: Complete the Weekly and Elite Weekly Acts each week, including Recovered ones from missed weeks.
ways.why: Weeklies give 4,500 standing and Elite Weeklies 7,000, and every 10,000 standing is a rank.

ways.how: Clear the daily Acts; each lasts 3 days, so you can catch up.
ways.why: 1,000 standing each, and they are the easiest tasks.

ways.how: Rank up through the season's 30 ranks, several of which award Creds, then keep earning standing for prestige ranks.
ways.why: In the current series, ranks 1 and 16 give 150 Cred and several others 50. Each prestige rank after 30 gives 15 Cred.

ways.how: Keep ranking even if you already own a Nightwave-exclusive reward.
ways.why: Duplicate Nightwave-exclusive rewards turn into 50 Cred.

tips: Each series has its own Cred that expires at the end; spend it before then.
Leftover Cred can be sold for 5,000 credits each after the series ends.
The shop rotates every 7 days, so check back for Catalysts and Reactors.
Weeklies refresh Sunday 00:00 UTC.

sum: Stela fuses Archon Shards and ranks up Cavia; it comes from Murmur enemies and Sarcophage containers in Albrecht's Laboratories, with The Fragmented fight a strong farm.

ways.how: Break the Murmur Sarcophage containers in the Murmur tiles of Albrecht's Laboratories; look on ledges and outcrops.
ways.why: Each one is a guaranteed 2-3 Stela.

ways.how: Fight The Fragmented and kill the enemies it spawns, stalling the fight to farm more. Bounty and Deep Archimedea versions spawn more enemies.
ways.why: Its spawned enemies have about a 5% chance each to drop Stela.

ways.how: Play Mirror Defense on Munio and collect Vosphene Glyphs.
ways.why: Every 50 Vosphene Glyphs collected gives Stela.

ways.how: Run Effervo, Nex or Persto in Albrecht's Laboratories and kill Murmur Fragments and Constructs.
ways.why: Murmur enemies occasionally drop Stela, and Sarcophage-opening bounties send you to them.

tips: Run Fissure missions with relics in the Laboratories; bonus Resource Boosters greatly increase Stela drops.
Rogue Necramechs don't drop Stela.
Fusing two primary shards costs 50 Stela, a Tauforged Ascent Fusion 100.
